Old London Bridge lined with houses
NO Wren dome or Wren steeples

ghi_chu.mo_ta: In the right-hand skyline there is a Gothic church with a square pinnacled tower. A separate slender pointed spire stands beside it. The building is short and compact. It does not read as the very long nave of Old St Paul's with a central crossing tower.
ghi_chu.ly_do: Old St Paul's in 1666 had a very long nave and a square crossing tower with no spire, because the spire was lost in 1561. A spired, compact church in this position is the wrong form for the landmark. Old St Paul's is not otherwise recognisable in the view.
